rows.grounds: fused compound of pibat (drinking) + dvandvaṃ (pair), accusative singular neuter
optative third singular active of vad (to speak)

items.question: What should the practitioner speak after drinking the pair and addressing kuṇḍalini?
premises: The verse lists drinking pair then kula then kuṇḍalini then speech.
It prescribes a sequence of ritual utterance.
The final verb is an optative instruction.
items.inference: The practitioner should speak after the prescribed drinking and kuṇḍalini invocation.
uncertainties: The exact referent of pibadvandvaṃ and kula remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Having spoken the kula of the drinking pair, then one should speak kuṇḍalini.
